existing.eligibility_summary: Must be non-Chinese citizens from Asia (citizens of Asian countries). Must meet Tsinghua University admission requirements for international master's students. Must demonstrate academic excellence, leadership potential, integrity, good English proficiency and presentation skills. Must not be offered other scholarships for study at Tsinghua. Must be able to attend mandatory enrichment programs at Beijing campus (not open to Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School applicants).
